card.text: Our home planet, the only place known to host life.

introduction.text: Earth is the third planet from the Sun and the fifth largest. Oceans cover about 71% of its surface.

normal.title: Blue Marble Next Generation
normal.summary: NASA Blue Marble, July 2004, midtones brightened. Deep ocean is shaded from depth, not observed water colour.

clouds.title: Blue Marble cloud composite
clouds.summary: Archival NASA clouds over the July 2004 mosaic; not live weather. Deep ocean is shaded from depth.

topography.title: GEBCO land and seafloor heights
topography.summary: GEBCO 2026 terrain: height and depth relative to mean sea level, with estimated ocean depths.

night-lights.title: Black Marble annual night lights · 2025
night-lights.summary: 2025 night-time radiance in false color on a log scale. Aurora can remain near the poles.

enso.title: Sea-surface temperature anomaly
enso.summary: Sea-surface temperature compared with the 2003–2014 average, on 7 September 2026. Gray covers land, ice and gaps.

cross-section.title: Interior structure model
cross-section.summary: Earth's crust, mantle, liquid outer core and solid inner core, sized by the NASA Science model.

mantle-tomography.title: GLAD-M35 mantle tomography
mantle-tomography.summary: Slower and faster mantle waves at each depth, in red and blue. This is not temperature.
